title: The wrong amplification value is used to calculate the new supply
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  When `addToken` is called to add a new token to the pool, one of the parameters that are provided are the new pool amplification factor for calculating supply and virtual balance prod.
